Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda (kecuali teksi

dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda (kecuali bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS) (NORTH SOUTH

EXPRESSWAY CENTRAL LINK AND KLIA EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT)

ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (North South Expressway Central Link and KLIA Expressway)

(Amendment) Order 2015.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 10 July 2015.

Amendment of paragraph 3

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (North South

Expressway Central Link and KLIA Expressway) Order 2002 [P.U. (A) 437/2002], which

is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 3(1) by

substituting for the words "Third Schedule C" wherever appearing the words

"Third Schedule D".

New Third Schedule D

3. The principal Order is amended by inserting after Third Schedule C the following

Schedule:

"THIRD SCHEDULE D

CLASSES OF VEHICLES

Class 1: Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels (excluding taxis and buses)

Class 2: Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels (excluding buses)

Class 3: Vehicles having three axles or more (excluding buses)

Class 4: Taxis

Class 5: Buses

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be included as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".
